newsitem.title: USA: Pepsico Taco Bell to appeal jury finding.
newsitem.headline: Pepsico Taco Bell to appeal jury finding.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc's Taco Bell unit said Tuesday it plans to appeal a jury finding that it is liable in a class action suit brought by current and former employeess in Washington State.
The jury found a pattern or practice of Taco Bell managers depriving employees of compensation by allowing them to work "off the clock."
Taco Bell Vice President Jonathan Blum said in a statement the company's policy is to pay employees for the actual time they work in the restaurants.
"We believe that evidence in this case indicated some isolated instances of managers who didn't follow our policies," he said. "Those individuals no longer work at Taco Bell."
